description: A FastAPI backend implementation for Ocean Motors API, including authentication, car listings, services, parts, service centers, and user profile management with in-memory data storage.

classes.name: LoginIn
classes.description: Model for login input containing email and password.

classes.name: RegisterIn
classes.description: Model for registration input extending LoginIn with a name.

classes.name: TokenOut
classes.description: Model for token response including access token, token type, and optional user info.

classes.name: Car
classes.description: Model representing a car with id, name, type, year, price, and is_new status.

classes.name: ServiceItem
classes.description: Model representing a service with id, name, price, and duration.

classes.name: PartItem
classes.description: Model representing a spare part with id, name, sku, and price.

classes.name: ServiceCenter
classes.description: Model representing a service center with id, name, address, location, and contact.

methods.name: verify_token
methods.description: Helper function to verify bearer token from headers.

methods.name: health
methods.description: Health check endpoint returning service status.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Authenticates user and returns a mock token.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers a new user and returns a mock token.

methods.name: get_cars
methods.description: Returns a list of latest cars.

methods.name: get_services
methods.description: Returns a list of available services.

methods.name: get_parts
methods.description: Returns a list of spare parts.

methods.name: get_centers
methods.description: Returns a list of service centers.

methods.name: get_profile
methods.description: Returns profile information for the current user.

methods.name: update_profile
methods.description: Updates the profile information for the current user.
